description: Persona smoke expectations for 'test-beta' (Rick's PR #108 second review: moved out of shared C# -- tests/conformance/tests/Conformance.Tests/PersonaSmokeTests.cs -- so no persona-specific literal lives there; a data-only pack PR adds only this file). Loaded by PersonaSmokeExpectations.For(personaId). Every field must be sourced from this SAME persona's own pack files, never invented: greetingSubstring from app/backend/tests/fixtures/personas/test-beta/prompts/greeting.yaml, and searchableOwnItem/orderableItemName/orderableItemSize/orderableItemPrice from app/backend/tests/fixtures/personas/test-beta/menu/menuItems.json (the size/price pair must match that file's entry exactly, or the add-to-order smoke step fails). test-beta's pricing.happyHour is null (persona-level, no per-item opt-in field to avoid either), so no happy-hour timing caveat applies here.
